phase: Android real-device rebuild of the paid membership UI. Root causes: (1) membership-center.wxss used px units + dark cards + white section titles on the light #f4f5f7 page (low contrast); (2) fixed cp-navbar with no body/safe-area offset; (3) membership-center read a non-existent getMembership {level,xp,streak,perks} shape and mapped membershipLevel('monthly') through the cognitive-level table; (4) an always-visible '升级会员解锁全部权益' upgrade bar shown to paid members; (5) raw permission codes (full_report/...) rendered via membership.permissions; (6) membership page hardcoded the 开通认知会员 title and showed the purchase block for paid members. Fix: server-authoritative member state (getMembership; UNKNOWN!=free), rpx responsive light-theme layout with safe-area + contrast-compliant text, membership identity card separate from cognitive growth (users.cv/level authority), authority-gated check-in, weekly-report section, human-readable rights labels via utils/membershipRights.js, and state-routed bottom CTA + nav titles. No payment function, payment signing, membership/entitlement record, or legacy-history change.
scope: pages/membership-center/{membership-center.js,wxml,wxss} (rebuilt) + pages/membership/{membership.js,wxml,wxss} (paid/free/expired/unknown title + detail state + human-readable rights) + pages/profile/profile.js (trailing-newline cleanup) + utils/membershipRights.js (new presenter) + tests/rc8.13/member-center.test.js (new, A-R) + tests/rc8.13/member-entry.test.js (rights objects + module stub) + tests/rc8.13/run.js + tests/rc8.9/report-preview-wiring.test.js (obsolete M4/M5 createOrder → createVirtualOrder) + .changes/current-change.json.
